title: Zariski separation of bottom supported Hom classes
statement: For the relative smooth pair of [lem-pur-relative-support-bottom-descent], two arbitrary supported Hom classes of degree 2c and twist c on a common etale neighbourhood agree if their restrictions agree on a Zariski neighbourhood of each point.

source.place: Restriction, elementary invariance, and final descent paragraphs

proof.text: Change from the diagonal annihilating exponent to the coefficient ring characteristic using the normalized twist comparison. The normalized supported-Hom and site comparisons identify the two classes with etale supported cohomology classes, and their displayed restrictions with the derived-kernel restrictions. Choose a neighbourhood for every point, a covering family in the small etale site. Apply the separatedness clause of bottom-degree descent, then cancel the coefficient and Hom comparisons.

theorem frameHom_zariski_separated (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {B V Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (b : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (v : V ⟶ B)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension P.level v] (i : Z ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [Smooth (i ≫ v)] (c : ℕ)
    (hcodim : ∀ z : Z, ringKrullDim (V.presheaf.stalk (i z)) =
      ringKrullDim (Z.presheaf.stalk z) + (c : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hfinite : ∀ z : Z, ringKrullDim (V.presheaf.stalk (i z)) ≠ ⊤)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) (e : U ⟶ V) [Etale e] (f : Fin c → Γ(U, ⊤))
    (tf : U.zeroLocusSubscheme (Set.range f) ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsPullback tf (U.zeroLocusSubschemeι (Set.range f)) i e)
    (α β : cupSupportedHom P (pullback.snd i e)
      ((cupSingle P U).obj (P.frameTwist U c)) (2 * (c : ℤ)))
    (hlocal : ∀ x : U, ∃ W : U.Opens, x ∈ W ∧
      ∀ sq : ChosenCartesianSquare
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i e) W.ι)
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i e) W.ι) (pullback.snd i e) W.ι,
      P.functorialCupPullback true _ _ W.ι _ sq (e ≫ v ≫ b) (2 * (c : ℤ)) c α =
      P.functorialCupPullback true _ _ W.ι _ sq (e ≫ v ≫ b) (2 * (c : ℤ)) c β) :
    α = β
